nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What method can be used to study animal viruses that can infect human cells, given the challenges of viral culturing?
nodes.answer: One method to study animal viruses is to use surrogate systems, such as viral pseudotypes, that recapitulate specific steps of the infection cycle by incorporating the receptor-binding protein of an enveloped virus into a viral vector.

nodes.question: What were the evaluated RBPs' viral internalization detection results mentioned in the text?
nodes.answer: Viral internalization was detected for 43 out of 102 RBPs, with an area under the curve (AUC) of 81.6%, sensitivity of 82.5%, and precision of 73.1%.
